answer_1.quote: We evaluate the state-of-the-art models and observe significant improvement in the emotional support provided when various support strategies are utilized.

answer_2.quote: The automatic metrics we adopted include perplexity (PPL), BLEU-2 (B-2), ROUGE-L (R-L), and the BOW Embedding-based Extrema matching score.

answer_4.quote: We recruited participants from Amazon Mechanical Turk to chat with the models. Participants were asked to compare the two models based on the following questions: (1) Fluency... (2) Identification... (3) Comforting... (4) Suggestion... (5) Overall...
answer_4.guideline: Participants compared models on fluency, problem identification depth, comforting skill, suggestion usefulness, and overall preference.
